test_command: mkdir -p /var/lib/fdb/data /var/log/fdb && echo 'docker:docker@127.0.0.1:4500' > /etc/fdb.cluster && fdbserver -p 127.0.0.1:4500 -l 127.0.0.1:4500 -d /var/lib/fdb/data -L /var/log/fdb -C /etc/fdb.cluster & sleep 10 && (fdbcli -C /etc/fdb.cluster --exec 'configure new single memory; status' --timeout 30 || true) && printf 'FDB_CLUSTER_FILE=/etc/fdb.cluster\n' > /workspace/repo/fdb-environment.properties && cd /workspace/repo && (./gradlew :fdb-record-layer-core:test --tests '*VersionIndexTest' --tests '*FDBMetaDataStoreTest' --tests '*FDBRecordStoreOpeningTest' --tests '*FDBRecordStoreTest' --no-daemon --no-watch-fs; GRADLE_EXIT=$?; find . -name 'TEST-*.xml' 2>/dev/null | xargs cat 2>/dev/null || true; exit $GRADLE_EXIT)
